question: Can successful south rotating-carry and high-speed north demonstrations, together with deployment-matched frozen-CNN caching and checkpoint evaluation, produce an offline-eligible ACT carry policy?
claim_limit: This is one combined data-and-numerical-path candidate, not an isolated causal test of the added demonstrations. Offline eligibility and physical carry success are separate outcomes.

source_boundaries.future_execution_bundle_version: v31 or later; v30 is reserved for a separate controller task

teacher_collection.plan: beam r1/r3 south, box r2 south first; serial service island and rotating_carry
teacher_collection.camera_input: own RGB, common TOP RGB, static goal/map, own issued command history
teacher_collection.resource: Local existing Mac simulation environment; sequential one-physics-owner runs, no concurrent training or heavy tests, no cloud or paid resources.
teacher_collection.failure_rule: Preserve every raw and managed failed/timeout attempt, do not replace a failed fixed case, and halt on source/input invariant failure. For each plan/run use the remaining aggregate time minus ten seconds of cleanup reserve, capped by its ordinary per-case bound; record the effective cap. Only mark a case unstarted when the cleanup reserve leaves no time. A case that fails the quality gate cannot be a success label.
teacher_collection.historical_budget_evidence: Old-source F3/F4 successful wall 1268.46/1215.26 s with last issued SIM 291.56 s; frozen v28 perturbed south timing is unknown.

teacher_managed_cli.prelaunch: From the frozen 931 source, run workflow plan with the same fixed/per-case trial arguments and save its resolved input hashes before workflow run. At run start verify no competing physics/training/heavy CPU owner. Preserve the exact expanded command in each managed manifest.

required: All three fixed cases have physical_success=true and protocol_complete=true with weld off, independently checked from raw result and managed manifest.
Each case has complete raw own and TOP RGB files with verified recorded SHA and exactly one terminal decision for each of r1/r3.
The unchanged build_carry_act_data.extract accepts every case and verifies actual decision-to-issued-command and renewal alignment.

Each slot in each new south case has at least 200 nonterminal issued decisions with absolute normalized lateral action >0.1 and at least 200 with absolute normalized turn action >0.1. The prior F3/F4 south examples exceed both counts in every slot.
All image SHA values are disjoint across the final train/development split and new case roots are distinct. Preserve the existing F3/F4, v25-repeat and v26-full development episodes in development.
Source, authored plan, scene/profile, camera, model input and environment hashes are captured in raw and managed records.
teacher_quality_gate_before_training.if_failed: Do not start the third ACT training or relabel held-out/failure episodes. Save gate counts and failure reasons.

dataset_construction_after_gate.builder: scripts/build_carry_act_data.py --base-dataset BASE --base-dataset-sha256 9cd42d3b6859fcb1526dab7ee675ba4349cf6fd32537d1c955a696e1e3197a57 --train ORIGINAL_DIAGNOSTIC_1 ORIGINAL_DIAGNOSTIC_2 SOUTH_TRAIN_A SOUTH_TRAIN_B --development SOUTH_DEVELOPMENT --out FRESH_DATASET
dataset_construction_after_gate.split_rule: Whole episodes only; no transfer from F3/F4 or any existing development episode. Original-spawn diagnostics add train coverage but are not independent scenes.

third_training_if_gate_passes.architecture: Pinned upstream ACT, frozen ResNet18, RGB 128, history 4, chunk 8; own/TOP RGB plus authored task/context and own issued commands only
third_training_if_gate_passes.objective: Unchanged upstream ACT chunk L1+KL plus class-balanced zero-latent deployed-first-action raw done MSE, weight 1.0
third_training_if_gate_passes.wall_cap_condition: A bounded 128-row representative benchmark must forecast B4 cache creation, 17 B1 development selections, 8000 optimizer updates and all-row native verification with headroom under 2400 s. If final teacher counts materially increase the projected rows, recalculate before source freeze/run; report any budget conflict.

preflight_timing_evidence.scope: Saved F3 tail 128 rows, selected failed diagnostic weights, no optimizer or physics
preflight_timing_evidence.uncertainty: Linear extrapolation from 128 rows cannot prove full-cache RSS or timing.

third_training_if_gate_passes.fixed_command: UGRP_SIM_PYTHON=/Users/changmin/Project-Runtimes/ugrp/.venv-reference-act/bin/python OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 bash scripts/open_simulation.command workflow run act-input-training --record FRESH_RECORD --timeout 2400 -- --dataset FRESH_DATASET --size 128 --history 4 --steps 8000 --seed 20260924 --device cpu --termination-objective deployed_first_action --deployed-done-weight 1.0 --feature-cache-mode deployed_window --cpu-evaluation-batch-size 1
third_training_if_gate_passes.selection: At fixed steps 1 and each 500 through 8000, select using held-out five-episode development metrics only; zero premature and zero missed terminal episodes is eligibility. Retain the best failing checkpoint as diagnostic without selecting again after final verification.
third_training_if_gate_passes.artifact_gate: After fixed updates and selection, every train and development row must match native one-sample RGB inference on the entire 8x4 action chunk under original atol=rtol=1e-5, with every chunk done>=0.65 decision identical; save cache/native metrics and per-row predictions, read back saved model and inference memo. Any failure preserves incomplete artifact, not a deployable model.
third_training_if_gate_passes.no_posthoc_change: No threshold, objective weight, seed, selected step, data split, tolerance, or optimizer retuning; no automatic retry.

physical_next_step: Only if the selected artifact is offline eligible and passes all artifact gates, freeze its model/source/bundle and conduct a separately preregistered matched RGB/ACT physical cohort. Do not call teacher replay or offline scores student physical success.
